package_updater=function(){
  #CRAN mirror (no prompts)
  options(repos=c(CRAN="https://cloud.r-project.org"))
  #Target library (first lib path)
  lib=.libPaths()[1]
  dir.create(lib,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  #Safe installer (binary-first, quiet, stable)
  safe_install=function(pkg,lib){
    tryCatch({
      message("Installing ",pkg," (binary)")
      install.packages(pkg,lib=lib,repos=getOption("repos"),dependencies=TRUE,type="binary",quiet=TRUE)
    },error=function(e){
      stop("Failed to install package: ",pkg,"\n",conditionMessage(e))
    })
  }
  #Required packages
  required_packages=c("readxl","dplyr","tidyr","stringr","stringi","janitor","tibble","lubridate","openxlsx",
                      "writexl","purrr","scales","tools","stringdist","pdftools","base64enc","glue","httr","magrittr",
                      "reticulate","fs","qpdf","emayili","blastula","rvest","jsonlite","xml2","curl","shiny",
                      "htmltools","zip","later","shinyjs")
  #Install missing packages
  installed=installed.packages(lib.loc=lib)[,"Package"]
  missing=setdiff(required_packages,installed)
  if(length(missing)){
    for(pkg in missing){
      safe_install(pkg,lib)
    }
  }
  #Critical package validation
  critical=c("stringi","pdftools","qpdf","shiny")
  for(pkg in critical){
    if(!requireNamespace(pkg,quietly=TRUE)){
      stop("Critical package failed to install: ",pkg)
    }
  }
  #Load packages quietly
  for(pkg in required_packages){
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg,character.only=TRUE,quietly=TRUE))
  }
  #Diagnostics: package versions
  package_versions=sapply(required_packages,function(pkg) as.character(packageVersion(pkg)))
  cat("\nLoaded package versions:\n")
  print(package_versions)
  #RDCOMClient (OmegaHat source)
  if(!requireNamespace("RDCOMClient",quietly=TRUE)){
    message("Installing RDCOMClient from OmegaHat...")
    install.packages("RDCOMClient",repos="http://www.omegahat.net/R",type="source")
  } else{
    message("RDCOMClient is already installed.")
  }
  library(RDCOMClient)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
convert_to_date=function(x){
  if(inherits(x,"Date")) return(x)
  #Handle factors
  if(is.factor(x)) x=as.character(x)
  #Handle character input
  if(is.character(x)){
    x_trimmed=trimws(x)
    #Replace non-date placeholders with NA
    x_trimmed[x_trimmed %in% c("00/00/0000","","NA","N/A","NaN")]=NA
    numeric_like=grepl("^\\d+$",x_trimmed)
    if(all(numeric_like[!is.na(x_trimmed)])){
      x=as.numeric(x_trimmed)
    } else{
      return(suppressWarnings(as.Date(x_trimmed,tryFormats=c("%Y-%m-%d","%m/%d/%Y","%d-%b-%y","%d/%m/%Y"))))
    }
  }
  #Handle numeric input
  if(is.numeric(x)){
    convert_single=function(val){
      if(is.na(val)) return(NA)
      if(val>=1e12){
        #Unix timestamp in milliseconds
        return(as.Date(as.POSIXct(val/1000,origin="1970-01-01",tz="UTC")))
      } else if(val>=1e5){
        #Unix timestamp in seconds
        return(as.Date(as.POSIXct(val,origin="1970-01-01",tz="UTC")))
      } else if(val>=30000){
        #Excel serial number or days since 1900
        return(as.Date(val,origin="1899-12-30"))
      } else if(val>0 && val<30000){
        #Excel serial number or days since 1970
        return(as.Date(val,origin="1970-01-01"))
      } else{
        return(NA)
      }
    }
    return(as.Date(vapply(x,convert_single,as.Date(NA))))
  }
  return(x)
}
rename_files=function(files){
  month_map=c(jan="01",january="01",feb="02",february="02",mar="03",march="03",apr="04",april="04",may="05",jun="06",
              june="06",jul="07",july="07",aug="08",august="08",sep="09",sept="09",september="09",oct="10",october="10",
              nov="11",november="11",dec="12",december="12")
  month_regex=paste(names(month_map),collapse="|")
  for(f in files){
    fname=basename(f)
    fname_lower=tolower(fname)
    #Skip Already Fromatted
    already_formatted=
      grepl("^\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\s+(payroll|census|pay date|fixed asset report)(\\sbonus)?\\.xls[x]?$",fname_lower)||
      grepl("^\\d{4}\\.q[1-4]\\s+(payroll|census|pay date)(\\sbonus)?\\.xls[x]?$",fname_lower)||
      grepl("^pay date\\s+\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}(\\sbonus)?\\.xls[x]?$",fname_lower)||
      grepl("^\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}\\s-\\s\\d{4}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}\\s+(payroll|census|pay date)(\\sbonus)?\\.xls[x]?$",fname_lower)
    if(already_formatted) next
    label=NA
    file_year=NA
    file_month=NA
    file_day=NA
    file_year_end=NA
    file_month_end=NA
    file_day_end=NA
    quarter_num=NA
    bonus_flag=grepl("bonus",fname_lower)
    #Fixed Asset Report
    if(grepl("fixed asset report",fname_lower)){
      label="Fixed Asset Report"
      #MMYYYY anywhere
      mm_match=str_match(fname_lower,"(\\d{2})(\\d{4})")
      if(!is.na(mm_match[1,1])){
        mm=mm_match[1,2]
        yy=mm_match[1,3]
        if(as.integer(mm)>=1 && as.integer(mm)<=12){
          file_month=mm
          file_year=yy
        }
      }
      #Month YYYY anywhere (incl parentheses)
      if(is.na(file_year)){
        month_match=str_match(fname_lower,paste0("(",month_regex,")\\s*(\\d{4})"))
        if(!is.na(month_match[1,1])){
          month_name=month_match[1,2]
          year_num=month_match[1,3]
          if(month_name %in% names(month_map)){
            file_month=month_map[[month_name]]
            file_year=year_num
          }
        }
      }
    }
    #Other Label Detection
    if(is.na(label)){
      if(grepl("hc|census",fname_lower)) label="Census"
      else if(grepl("payroll",fname_lower)) label="Payroll"
      else if(grepl("pay date",fname_lower)) label="Pay Date"
      else next
    }
    #Date Range
    if(label!="Fixed Asset Report"){
      date_range_pattern="(\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{2})[\\s\\-]+(\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{2})"
      range_match=str_match(fname_lower,date_range_pattern)
      if(!all(is.na(range_match))){
        convert_year=function(yy){
          if(as.integer(yy)<50) paste0("20",yy) else paste0("19",yy)
        }
        file_year=convert_year(range_match[,4])
        file_month=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(range_match[,2]))
        file_day=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(range_match[,3]))
        file_year_end=convert_year(range_match[,7])
        file_month_end=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(range_match[,5]))
        file_day_end=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(range_match[,6]))
      } else{
        #Quarter + Year
        qy=str_match(fname_lower,"(?:(\\d{4})\\s*(?:q|qtr|quarter)\\s*([1-4])|(?:q|qtr|quarter)\\s*([1-4])\\s*(\\d{4}))")
        if(!all(is.na(qy))){
          if(!is.na(qy[2]) && !is.na(qy[3])){
            file_year=qy[2]
            quarter_num=as.integer(qy[3])
          } else if(!is.na(qy[4]) && !is.na(qy[5])){
            quarter_num=as.integer(qy[4])
            file_year=qy[5]
          }
        }
        #Quarter Without Year
        if(is.na(quarter_num)){
          qm=str_match(fname_lower,"(?:([1-4])\\s*qtr|([1-4])\\s*q)")
          if(!all(is.na(qm))){
            quarter_num=as.integer(na.omit(qm[2:3])[1])
          }
        }
        if(!is.na(quarter_num)){
          if(is.na(file_year)){
            created_time=file.info(f)$ctime
            if(!is.na(created_time)) file_year=format(created_time,"%Y")
          }
          file_month=sprintf("%02d",c(3,6,9,12)[quarter_num])
          file_day="01"
        } else{
          #MM.DD.YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY first
          mdy_alt=str_match(fname_lower,"(\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{1,2})[\\.\\-](\\d{4})")
          if(!all(is.na(mdy_alt))){
            file_month=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(mdy_alt[1,2]))
            file_day=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(mdy_alt[1,3]))
            file_year=mdy_alt[1,4]
          } else {
            #Existing YMD
            ymd=str_match(fname,"(\\d{4})[-\\.]?(\\d{1,2})(?:[-\\.]?(\\d{1,2}))?")
            mdy=str_match(fname,"(\\d{1,2})[-\\.]?(\\d{1,2})[-\\.]?(\\d{4})")
            if(!all(is.na(ymd)) && !is.na(ymd[1,2])){
              file_year=ymd[1,2]
              file_month=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(ymd[1,3]))
              if(!is.na(ymd[1,4])) file_day=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(ymd[1,4]))
            } else if(!all(is.na(mdy)) && !is.na(mdy[1,4])){
              file_month=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(mdy[1,1]))
              file_day=sprintf("%02d",as.integer(mdy[1,2]))
              file_year=mdy[1,3]
            }
          }
          #Fallback year
          if(is.na(file_year)){
            created_time=file.info(f)$ctime
            if(!is.na(created_time)) file_year=format(created_time,"%Y")
          }
        }
      }
    }
    #Build Final Name
    ext=file_ext(fname)
    new_name=NA
    if(!is.na(file_year_end)){
      new_name=paste0(label, " ",file_year,".",file_month,".",file_day," - ",file_year_end,".",file_month_end,".",file_day_end)
    } else if(!is.na(quarter_num) && !is.na(file_year)){
      new_name=paste0(label, " ",file_year,".Q",quarter_num)
    } else if(!is.na(file_year) && !is.na(file_month)){
      if(!is.na(file_day)) new_name=paste0(label, " ", file_year,".",file_month,".",file_day)
      else new_name=paste0(label, " ",file_year,".",file_month)
    }
    if(bonus_flag && !is.na(new_name)) new_name=paste(new_name,"Bonus")
    #Rename
    if(!is.na(new_name)){
      new_file=file.path(dirname(f), paste0(new_name,".",ext))
      if(f!=new_file){
        file.rename(f,new_file)
        message("Renamed: ",fname," -> ",basename(new_file))
      }
    }
  }
}
column_renaming_assets=function(df_list){
  envir=parent.frame()
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Balance Sheet Date column
    idx_bs=grep("balance[\\s._]*sheet[\\s._]*date",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_bs)>=1){
      colnames(df)[idx_bs[1]]="Balance Sheet Date"
    }
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)
  }
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Plant Name column
    idx_cc=grep("plant[\\s._]*name",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_cc)>=1){

    }
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)

  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Profit Center column
    idx_cc=grep("profit[\\s._]*center",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_cc)>=1){
      colnames(df)[idx_cc[1]]="Profit Center"
    }
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)
  }
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Plant Code column
    idx_cc=grep("plant[\\s._]*code",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_cc)>=1){
      colnames(df)[idx_cc[1]]="Plant Code"
    }
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)

  for(df_name in df_list){

    #Balance Sheet Account column
    idx_bs=grep("balance[\\s._]*sh[\\s._]*acct[\\s._]*apc",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_bs)>=1){

    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)

  for(df_name in df_list){

  for(df_name in df_list){

  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Municipality
    idx_ac=grep("municipality",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_ac)>=1) colnames(df)[idx_ac[1]]="Municipality"
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)
  }
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Location
    idx_ac=grep("location",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_ac)>=1) colnames(df)[idx_ac[1]]="Location"
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)
  }
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Plant (exact match, ignore case)
    idx_plant=grep("^plant$",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_plant)==1){
      colnames(df)[idx_plant]="Plant"
    }
    assign(df_name,df,envir=envir)
  }
  for(df_name in df_list){
    df=get(df_name,envir=envir)
    #Company Code
    idx_ac=grep("company[\\s._]*code",colnames(df),ignore.case=TRUE)
    if(length(idx_ac)>=1) colnames(df)[idx_ac[1]]="Company Code"

automate_excel_save=function(file_path){
  #Force creation of a NEW Excel instance (not connecting to existing)
  excel_app=COMCreate("Excel.Application",existing=FALSE)
  excel_app[["Visible"]]=FALSE
  excel_app[["DisplayAlerts"]]=FALSE
  excel_app[["ScreenUpdating"]]=FALSE
  #Normalize the file path
  file_path=normalizePath(file_path,winslash="\\",mustWork=TRUE)
  #Open the workbook
  workbook=excel_app[["Workbooks"]]$Open(file_path)
  #Force recalculation and refresh
  excel_app$CalculateFullRebuild()
  workbook$RefreshAll()
  #Wait for calculations to complete
  if("CalculateUntilAsyncQueriesDone" %in% names(excel_app)){
    excel_app$CalculateUntilAsyncQueriesDone()
  }
  #Save and close
  workbook$Save()
  workbook$Close(SaveChanges=FALSE)
  #Quit this instance
  excel_app$Quit()
  #Clean up
  rm(workbook,excel_app)
  gc()
}

asset_tracking_model=function(company,start_month=NULL,end_month=NULL,start_quarter=NULL,
                              end_quarter=NULL,start_year,end_year){
  package_updater()
  #Input validations
  validate_inputs=function(company,start_month=NULL,end_month=NULL,start_quarter=NULL,end_quarter=NULL,
                           start_year,end_year){
    #Company validation
    if(!is.character(company)){
      stop("Error: Company must be a string.")
    }
    #Year validation
    if(is.null(start_year)||is.null(end_year)){
      stop("Error: Both 'start_year' and 'end_year' must be provided.")
    }
    if(!is.numeric(start_year)||start_year<=0||start_year!=as.integer(start_year)){
      stop("Error: 'start_year' must be a positive nonzero integer.")
    }
    if(!is.numeric(end_year)||end_year<=0||end_year!=as.integer(end_year)){
      stop("Error: 'end_year' must be a positive nonzero integer.")
    }
    if(start_year>end_year){
      stop("Error: 'start_year' must be before or equal to 'end_year'.")
    }
    #Month vs Quarter exclusivity
    if((!is.null(start_month)||!is.null(end_month)) && (!is.null(start_quarter)||!is.null(end_quarter))){
      stop("Error: Provide either month range or quarter range, not both.")
    }
    #Month validation
    if(!is.null(start_month)||!is.null(end_month)){
      if(is.null(start_month)||is.null(end_month)){
        stop("Error: Both 'start_month' and 'end_month' must be provided together.")
      }
      if(!is.character(start_month)||!is.character(end_month)){
        stop("Error: Months must be strings.")
      }
      valid_months=month.name
      if(!(start_month %in% valid_months)){
        stop(paste("Error: Invalid 'start_month'. Must be one of:",paste(valid_months,collapse=", ")))
      }
      if(!(end_month %in% valid_months)){
        stop(paste("Error: Invalid 'end_month'. Must be one of:",paste(valid_months,collapse=", ")))
      }
      #Chronological check for months
      start_idx=match(start_month,valid_months)
      end_idx=match(end_month,valid_months)
      if(start_year==end_year && start_idx>end_idx){
        stop("Error: 'start_month' must not be after 'end_month' within the same year.")
      }
    }
    #Quarter validation
    if(!is.null(start_quarter)||!is.null(end_quarter)){
      if(is.null(start_quarter)||is.null(end_quarter)){
        stop("Error: Both 'start_quarter' and 'end_quarter' must be provided together.")
      }
      if(!is.numeric(start_quarter)||!(start_quarter %in% 1:4)){
        stop("Error: 'start_quarter' must be a number between 1 and 4.")
      }
      if(!is.numeric(end_quarter)||!(end_quarter %in% 1:4)){
        stop("Error: 'end_quarter' must be a number between 1 and 4.")
      }
      #Chronological check for quarters
      if(start_year==end_year && start_quarter>end_quarter){
        stop("Error: 'start_quarter' must not be after 'end_quarter' within the same year.")
      }
    }
    return(TRUE) #Passed all checks
  }
  validate_inputs(company=company,start_month=start_month,end_month=end_month,start_quarter=start_quarter,
                  end_quarter=end_quarter,start_year=start_year,end_year=end_year)
  directory="K:/Atlas Automation/"
  #Define file path and sheet
  file_path=paste0(directory,"Programs/Asset Tracking/",company,"/",company," Asset Tracking Report.xlsx")
  if(file.exists(file_path)){
    wb=loadWorkbook(file_path)
    all_sheets=names(wb)
    #Helper to convert sheet names into actual dates
    parse_period_date=function(name){
      if(grepl("^[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]{4}$",name)){ #"03.2025"
        parts=strsplit(name,"\\.")[[1]]
        month=as.integer(parts[1])
        year=as.integer(parts[2])
        return(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,month)))
      } else if(grepl("^Q[1-4]\\.[0-9]{4}$",name)){ #"Q1.2025"
        parts=strsplit(name,"\\.")[[1]]
        quarter=as.integer(sub("Q","",parts[1]))
        year=as.integer(parts[2])
        month_equiv=(quarter-1)*3+1 #Q1 = Jan, Q2 = Apr, etc.
        return(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,month_equiv)))
      } else{
        return(as.Date(NA)) #Not a recognized period
      }
    }
    #Determine period cutoff
    if(!is.null(start_month)){
      month_num=match(tolower(start_month),tolower(month.name))
      start_date=as.Date(paste0(start_year,"-",sprintf("%02d",month_num),"-01"))
      month_upper=paste0(toupper(substr(start_month,1,1)),tolower(substr(start_month,2,nchar(start_month))))
      period_label_sheet=sprintf("%02d.%d",month_num,start_year) #"MM.YYYY"
      period_label_form=paste0(substr(month_upper,1,3),"-",substr(start_year,3,4)) #"MMM-YY"
    } else if(!is.null(start_quarter)){
      start_month_num=(start_quarter-1)*3+1
      start_date=as.Date(paste0(start_year,"-",sprintf("%02d",start_month_num),"-01"))
      period_label_sheet=paste0("Q",start_quarter,".",start_year) #"QX.YYYY"
      period_label_form=paste0("Q",start_quarter," ",start_year) #"QX YYYY"   
    } else{
      stop("Either month or quarter must be defined.")
    }
    #Identify period-based sheets
    period_pattern="^(?:[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]{4}|Q[1-4]\\.[0-9]{4})$"
    period_sheets=grep(period_pattern,all_sheets,value=TRUE)
    #Convert their names into dates
    period_dates=sapply(period_sheets,parse_period_date)
    #Remove current + future periods
    future_sheets=period_sheets[period_dates>=start_date]
    for(s in future_sheets) removeWorksheet(wb,s)
    #Save
    wb$ActiveSheet=1L
  } else{
    message("File does not exist: ",file_path," — skipping.")
  }
  #Function to get cutoff date depending on mode
  get_cutoff=function(year,month=NULL,quarter=NULL){
    if(!is.null(month)){
      #Month mode → cutoff = 1st of that month
      month_num=match(month,month.name)
      list(cutoff_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month_num)),type="month")
    } else if(!is.null(quarter)){
      #Quarter mode → cutoff = 1st of first month in that quarter
      month_num=(quarter-1)*3+1
      list(cutoff_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month_num)),type="quarter")
    } else{
      stop("Must provide either month or quarter.")
    }
  }
  #Parse YYYY.MM or YYYY.QX into a date and type
  parse_period=function(p){
    if(str_detect(p,"Q")){
      year=as.integer(str_extract(p,"^\\d{4}"))
      q=as.integer(str_extract(p,"(?<=Q)\\d"))
      month_num=(q-1)*3+1
      list(date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month_num)),type="quarter")
    } else{
      year=as.integer(str_extract(p,"^\\d{4}"))
      month=as.integer(str_extract(p,"(?<=\\.)\\d{2}"))
      list(date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month)),type="month")
    }
  }
  report_function=function(company,month=NULL,quarter=NULL,year){
    start_time_1=Sys.time()
    #Input validations
    if(!is.null(month) && !is.null(quarter)){
      stop("Error: Provide either 'month' or 'quarter', not both.")
    }
    if(is.null(month) && is.null(quarter)){
      stop("Error: You must provide either 'month' or 'quarter'.")
    }
    if(!is.character(company)){
      stop("Error: Company must be a string.")
    }
    if(!is.null(month) && !is.character(month)){
      stop("Error: Month must be a string.")
    }
    if(!is.null(quarter) && (!is.numeric(quarter)||!(quarter %in% 1:4))){
      stop("Error: Quarter must be a number between 1 and 4.")
    }
    if(!is.numeric(year)||year<=0||year!=as.integer(year)){
      stop("Error: The year must be a positive nonzero integer.")
    }
    #Status message
    if(!is.null(month)){
      message("Running model for company: ",company," | Month: ",month," ",year)
    } else{
      message("Running model for company: ",company," | Quarter: Q",quarter," ",year)
    }
    #Locate files
    folder_path=paste0(directory,"Programs/Asset Tracking/",company,"/Asset Reports")
    all_files=list.files(path=folder_path,pattern="\\.xls[x]?$",full.names=TRUE)
    rename_files(all_files)
    all_files=list.files(path=folder_path,pattern="\\.xls[x]?$",full.names=TRUE)
    all_files_lower=tolower(all_files)
    #Initialize list of month variants
    month_variants=character(0)
    if(!is.null(month)){
      #Add variants for single month
      month_num=match(tolower(month),tolower(month.name))
      month_variants=tolower(c(month,substr(month,1,3),sprintf("%02d",month_num),as.character(month_num)))
      #Determine quarter of this month
      quarter_from_month=ceiling(month_num/3)
    }
    if(!is.null(quarter)){
      #Expand quarter months and generate variants
      quarter_months_list=list(c("January","February","March"),c("April","May","June"),c("July","August","September"),
                               c("October","November","December"))
      quarter_months=quarter_months_list[[as.integer(quarter)]]
      for(m in quarter_months){
        m_num=match(tolower(m),tolower(month.name))
        month_variants=c(month_variants,tolower(c(m,substr(m,1,3),sprintf("%02d",m_num),as.character(m_num))))
      }
    }
    #Remove duplicates
    month_variants=unique(month_variants)
    #Match any file that includes the year and at least one month variant
    file_matches=all_files[sapply(seq_along(all_files_lower),function(i){
      fname=all_files_lower[i]
      has_year=grepl(paste0("\\b",year,"\\b"),fname)
      has_month=any(sapply(month_variants,function(mv){
        grepl(paste0("(^|[^[:alnum:]])",mv,"([^[:alnum:]]|$)"),fname)
      }))
      has_year && has_month
    })]
    #If no matches, try matching quarter keywords
    if(length(file_matches)==0 && !is.null(quarter)){
      quarter_keywords=c("quarter","qtr",paste0("q",quarter))
      file_matches=all_files[sapply(all_files_lower,function(fname){
        grepl(year,fname) && any(sapply(quarter_keywords,function(qk) grepl(qk,fname)))
      })]
    }
    #Also allow YYYY.QX formatted files
    if(length(file_matches)==0){
      if(!is.null(month)){
        #Get quarter from month
        q=quarter_from_month
        pattern=paste0("\\b",year,"\\.q",q,"\\b")
        file_matches=all_files[grepl(pattern,all_files_lower)]
      } else if(!is.null(quarter)){
        pattern=paste0("\\b",year,"\\.q",quarter,"\\b")
        file_matches=all_files[grepl(pattern,all_files_lower)]
      }
    }
    #Import matched files
    if(length(file_matches)==0){
      warning("No matching files found.")
    } else{
      for(file_path in file_matches){
        #Generate a safe data frame name
        df_name=paste0("df_",gsub("[^[:alnum:]]","_",tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))))
        #Check if the sheet "DataBase" exists
        sheets=excel_sheets(file_path)
        if("DataBase" %in% sheets){
          df=read_excel(file_path,sheet="DataBase")
        } else{
          df=read_excel(file_path) #Default first sheet
        }
        #Assign to environment
        assign(df_name,df)
        print(paste("Imported:",df_name))
      }
    }
    #List all objects in the environment matching the pattern
    all_objects=ls(pattern="^df_")
    #Filter only objects that are data frames
    df_list=all_objects[sapply(all_objects,function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]
    clean_and_transform_new=function(df){  
      #Convert everything to character first
      df=df%>%mutate(across(everything(),as.character))
      #Remove mostly-empty columns
      n_rows_to_check=min(10,nrow(df))
      keep_cols=sapply(df,function(col){
        first_rows=col[1:n_rows_to_check]
        majority_na=mean(is.na(col)|col=="")<=0.95
        first_rows_nonempty=any(!is.na(first_rows) & first_rows!="")
        majority_na && first_rows_nonempty
      })
      df=df[,keep_cols,drop=FALSE]
      #Shift header if needed
      is_numbered_format=function(string) grepl("^\\.\\.\\..*\\d+$",string)
      column_names=colnames(df)
      if(sum(sapply(column_names,is_numbered_format))>=length(column_names)/2){
        full_rows=which(rowSums(!is.na(df) & df!="")==ncol(df))
        first_full_row=if(length(full_rows)>0) full_rows[1] else NA
        if(!is.na(first_full_row)){
          colnames(df)=as.character(df[first_full_row,])
          df=df[(first_full_row+1):nrow(df),]
        }
      }
      #Clean column names
      df=df%>%clean_names()
      #Trim to last majority-full row
      majority_full_rows=which(rowSums(!is.na(df) & df!="")>=ncol(df)/2)
      if(length(majority_full_rows)>0) df=df[1:max(majority_full_rows),]
      #Numeric conversion
      df=df%>%mutate(across(everything(),~{
        x=gsub("[$,]","",.x)
        if(all(is.na(x)|grepl("^[-]?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$",x))) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)) else .x
      }))
      return(df)
    }
    clean_and_transform=function(df){
      #Function to check if a string is in the format "...NUMBER"
      is_numbered_format=function(string){
        grepl("^\\.\\.\\..*\\d+$",string)  #Match columns starting with "..." followed by digits
      }
      #Get the column names of the data frame
      column_names=colnames(df)
      #Check if majority of the column titles are in the format "...NUMBER"
      if(sum(sapply(column_names,is_numbered_format))>=length(column_names)/2){
        #If majority are in the desired format, process the data frame
        #Identify the first full row with all non-NA values
        first_full_row=which(apply(df,1,function(row) all(!is.na(row))))[1]
        if(length(first_full_row)==0){
          return(df) #Return original if no full row exists
        }
        #Extract the contents of this row to use as new column names
        new_column_names=as.character(df[first_full_row,])
        #Remove rows up to and including this identified row
        cleaned_df=df[(first_full_row+1):nrow(df),]
        #Apply the new column names
        colnames(cleaned_df)=new_column_names
      } else{
        #If majority are not in the desired format, return the data frame as is
        cleaned_df=df
      }
      #Clean column names using janitor (if needed)
      cleaned_df=cleaned_df%>%clean_names()
      #Function to check if a row is majority full (at least half non-NA values)
      majority_full_row=function(row){
        sum(!is.na(row))>=length(row)/2
      }
      #Find the last majority full row
      majority_full_rows=which(apply(cleaned_df,1,majority_full_row))
      if(length(majority_full_rows)>0){
        last_majority_full_row=max(majority_full_rows)
        cleaned_df=cleaned_df[1:last_majority_full_row,]
      }
      #Convert numeric columns
      for(col_name in colnames(cleaned_df)){
        if(all(grepl("^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$",cleaned_df[[col_name]]))){
          cleaned_df[[col_name]]=as.numeric(cleaned_df[[col_name]])
        }
      }
      return(cleaned_df)
    }
    #Apply the cleaning function to each data frame and reassign it
    for(df_name in df_list){
      cleaned_data=clean_and_transform_new(get(df_name))
      #Reassign the cleaned data frame back to its original name
      assign(df_name,cleaned_data)
      #Print confirmation
      print(paste("Cleaned and transformed:",df_name))
    }
    column_renaming_assets(df_list=df_list)
    combined_asset_data=do.call(rbind,lapply(df_list,function(df_name) get(df_name)))
    combined_asset_data$`Acquisition Value`=as.numeric(combined_asset_data$`Acquisition Value`)
    #Only replace numeric codes if "Asset Class" column exists
    if("Asset Class" %in% colnames(combined_asset_data)){
      #Extract the column and convert to character
      ac=as.character(combined_asset_data$`Asset Class`)
      #Identify rows that do NOT contain any letters (a-z or A-Z)
      is_numeric_code=!grepl("[a-zA-Z]",ac)
      #Replace blanks (NA or "") with 0
      ac[is_numeric_code & (is.na(ac)|ac=="")]="0"
      #Map numeric codes to descriptions
      code_map=list("0"="0","4100"="Asset Under Construction",
                    "1500"="Construction on Other Land","1400"="Construction on Owned Property",
                    "1401"="Construction on Owned Property","2000"="Conventional Equipment and Instalations (MIC)",
                    "2001"="Conventional Equipment and Instalations (MIC)","2500"="Conventional Industrial Tools",
                    "3000"="Data Processing & Office Automation Equipment","3001"="Data Processing & Office Automation Equipment",
                    "2100"="Equis and Installations Sensitive to Tech Changes","2101"="Equis and Installations Sensitive to Tech Changes",
                    "1600"="Improvements and Fixtures of Constructions","7100"="Intangible Assets (not an Asset Class per se)",
                    "1001"="Land","1100"="Land Improvement & Fixtures","1101"="Land Improvement & Fixtures",
                    "1300"="Leasehold Improvement & Fixtures","6100"="Licenses","3400"="Office Equipment & Social Equipment",
                    "3401"="Office Equipment & Social Equipment","2200"="Other Computarized Equipment and Installations",
                    "2201"="Other Computarized Equipment and Installations","6900"="Other Intangible Assets",
                    "3900"="Other Tangible Asset","3901"="Other Tangible Asset","5200"="Research & Development Cost Electronics",
                    "5100"="Research & Development Cost Hardware Electronics","5300"="Software","5301"="Software",
                    "2600"="Special Tools","2601"="Special Tools","3200"="Transportation Equipment","3201"="Transportation Equipment")
      #Replace numeric codes with mapped descriptions
      ac[is_numeric_code]=sapply(ac[is_numeric_code],function(x){
        x=as.character(x) #Ensure character
        if(x %in% names(code_map)) code_map[[x]] else x
      })
      #Assign back to dataframe
      combined_asset_data$`Asset Class`=ac
    }
    combined_asset_data$Asset=as.character(combined_asset_data$Asset)
    combined_asset_data$`Capitalization Date`=as.Date(combined_asset_data$`Capitalization Date`)
    combined_asset_data$`Acquisition Date`=as.Date(combined_asset_data$`Acquisition Date`)
    file_path=paste0(directory,"Programs/Asset Tracking/",company,"/",company," Asset Tracking Report.xlsx")
    sheet_name="Combined Asset Data"
    #If file exists, load it; otherwise create new workbook
    if(file.exists(file_path)){
      wb=loadWorkbook(file_path)
    } else{
      wb=createWorkbook()
    }
    #Remove sheet if it already exists
    if(sheet_name %in% names(wb)){
      removeWorksheet(wb,sheet_name)
    }
    #Add new sheet
    addWorksheet(wb,sheet_name,tabColour="#8B0000")
    #Write data
    writeData(wb,sheet=sheet_name,combined_asset_data)
    cols_to_format=c("Balance Sheet Date","Plant Name","Profit Center","Plant Code","Asset Class Name")
    existing_cols=intersect(cols_to_format,names(combined_asset_data))
    num_existing=length(existing_cols)
    #Freeze top row + first 5 columns
    freezePane(wb,sheet=sheet_name,firstActiveRow=2,firstActiveCol=num_existing+1)
    #Bold header row
    header_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_style,rows=1,cols=1:ncol(combined_asset_data),gridExpand=TRUE)
    #Add filters
    addFilter(wb,sheet=sheet_name,rows=1,cols=1:ncol(combined_asset_data))
    #Find Balance Sheet Date column index
    bsd_col=which(colnames(combined_asset_data)=="Balance Sheet Date")
    if(length(bsd_col)==1){
      #Header style: black fill + white bold text
      bsd_header_style=createStyle(fgFill="#000000",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bsd_header_style,rows=1,cols=bsd_col,stack=TRUE)
      #Body style: grey fill + date format MMM-YY
      bsd_body_style=createStyle(fgFill="#BFBFBF",numFmt="mmm-yy") 
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bsd_body_style,rows=2:(nrow(combined_asset_data)+1),cols=bsd_col,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    cols_to_format=c("Plant Name","Profit Center","Plant Code","Asset Class Name")
    #Find column indices in combined_asset_data
    col_idx=which(names(combined_asset_data) %in% cols_to_format)
    if(length(col_idx)>0){
      #Header style
      header_style=createStyle(fgFill="#806000",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
      #Body style
      body_style=createStyle(fgFill="#FFF2CC")
      #Apply header style
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_style,rows=1,cols=col_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      #Apply body style
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=body_style,rows=2:(nrow(combined_asset_data)+1),cols=col_idx,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    special_cols=c("Balance Sheet Date","Plant Name","Profit Center","Plant Code","Asset Class Name","Plant")
    all_cols=names(combined_asset_data)
    #Columns that get orange header (everything except special)
    other_cols=setdiff(all_cols,special_cols)
    other_idx=which(all_cols %in% other_cols)
    #Plant column index
    plant_idx=which(all_cols=="Plant")
    #Styles
    header_orange=createStyle(fgFill="#ED7D31",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
    header_plant=createStyle(fgFill="#548235",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
    #Apply orange to all non-special columns
    if(length(other_idx)>0){
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_orange,rows=1,cols=other_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Apply Plant header style
    if(length(plant_idx)==1){
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_plant,rows=1,cols=plant_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    date_cols=c("Capitalization Date","Acquisition Date")
    #Apply date formatting for each column if it exists
    for(col_name in date_cols){
      col_idx=which(names(combined_asset_data)==col_name)
      if(length(col_idx)==1){
        date_style=createStyle(numFmt="DATE")
        addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=date_style,rows=2:(nrow(combined_asset_data)+1),cols=col_idx,
                  gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      }
    }
    acct_cols=c("Acquisition Value","Accumulated Depreciation","Book Value")
    acct_idx=which(names(combined_asset_data) %in% acct_cols)
    if(length(acct_idx)>0){
      acct_style=createStyle(numFmt="ACCOUNTING")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=acct_style,rows=2:(nrow(combined_asset_data)+1),cols=acct_idx,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    message("Combined Asset Data sheet updated.")
    #Ensure Balance Sheet Date is Date class
    combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`=as.Date(combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`)
    asset_report=combined_asset_data[0,] #Default empty
    if(!is.null(quarter)){
      #Quarter start/end months
      quarter_start=c(1,4,7,10)[quarter]
      quarter_end=c(3,6,9,12)[quarter]
      start_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,quarter_start))
      #End of quarter = last day of quarter_end month
      end_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-%02d",year,quarter_end, 
                                as.integer(format(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,quarter_end))+months(1)-1,"%d"))))
      asset_report=combined_asset_data[combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`>=start_date &
                                        combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`<=end_date,]
    } else if(!is.null(month)){
      month_map=setNames(1:12,month.name)
      month_num=month_map[[month]]
      start_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month_num))
      end_date=as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-%02d",year,month_num, 
                                as.integer(format(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,month_num))+months(1)-1,"%d"))))
      asset_report=combined_asset_data[combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`>=start_date &
                                        combined_asset_data$`Balance Sheet Date`<=end_date,]
    }
    #Reset row names
    rownames(asset_report)=NULL
    if(company=="Schneider Electric"){
      #Find the index of "Plant Name"
      plant_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Plant Name")
      #Create a new column "MJ1/MJ2" initialized with NA
      new_col=rep(NA,nrow(asset_report))
      #Insert the new column after "Plant Name"
      asset_report=cbind(asset_report[,1:plant_col_idx,drop=FALSE],`MJ1/MJ2`=new_col,
                          asset_report[,(plant_col_idx+1):ncol(asset_report),drop=FALSE])
    }
    effective_dates_file_path=paste0(directory,"Programs/Asset Tracking/Asset Tracking Effective Dates.xlsx")
    #Check if file exists first
    if(file.exists(effective_dates_file_path)){
      effective_dates=read_excel(effective_dates_file_path)
    } else{
      stop("File does not exist: ",effective_dates_file_path)
    }
    #Filter effective_dates for the selected company
    effective_dates_sub=effective_dates[effective_dates$Company==company,]
    #Get unique plant locations for this company
    plant_locations=sort(unique(effective_dates_sub$`Plant Location`))
    #Create empty asset_tracking data frame with the columns
    column_names=c("Asset Class","Asset Class Description",plant_locations)
    asset_tracking=data.frame(matrix(ncol=length(column_names),nrow=0))
    colnames(asset_tracking)=column_names
    #List of asset class descriptions
    asset_classes=c("0","Asset Under Construction","Construction on Other Land",
                    "Construction on Owned Property","Improvements and Fixtures of Constructions","Land",
                    "Land Improvement & Fixtures","Leasehold Improvement & Fixtures",
                    "Conventional Equipment and Instalations (MIC)","Conventional Industrial Tools",
                    "Data Processing & Office Automation Equipment","Equis and Installations Sensitive to Tech Changes",
                    "Office Equipment & Social Equipment","Other Computarized Equipment and Installations",
                    "Other Tangible Asset","Research & Development Cost Electronics",
                    "Research & Development Cost Hardware Electronics","Special Tools","Transportation Equipment",
                    "Licenses","Other Intangible Assets","Software","Intangible Assets (not an Asset Class per se)",
                    "TOTAL","Assets Under Construction","ELIGIBLE REAL PROPERTY","ELIGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY")
    #Get plant columns from existing asset_tracking
    plant_columns=setdiff(colnames(asset_tracking),c("Asset Class","Asset Class Description"))
    #Combine all column names
    all_cols=c("Asset Class","Asset Class Description",plant_columns)
    #Create empty data frame with correct number of rows and columns
    asset_tracking=data.frame(matrix(NA,ncol=length(all_cols),nrow=length(asset_classes)))
    #Assign column names
    colnames(asset_tracking)=all_cols
    #Fill "Asset Class Description" column
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description`=asset_classes
    #Initialize "Asset Class" column to NA (or 0 if preferred)
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class`=NA
    #Initialize all plant columns to NA (already NA from matrix, safe)
    for(col in plant_columns){
      asset_tracking[[col]]=NA
    }
    #Assign values to specific rows in "Asset Class"
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class`[1]="Assets Under Construction"
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class`[3]="Real Property"
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class`[9]="Personal Property"
    asset_tracking$`Asset Class`[20]="Intangible Assets"
    #Determine period end date
    if(!is.null(month) && is.null(quarter)){
      month_num=match(tolower(month),tolower(month.name))
      period_end=ceiling_date(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,month_num)),"month")-days(1)
    } else if(!is.null(quarter) && is.null(month)){
      end_month=c(3,6,9,12)[quarter]
      period_end=as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d",year,end_month,days_in_month(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,end_month)))))
    } else{
      stop("Provide either month OR quarter")
    }
    sheet_name=format(period_end,"%m.%d.%Y")
    #Replace sheet
    if(sheet_name %in% names(wb)){
      removeWorksheet(wb,sheet_name)
    }
    addWorksheet(wb,sheet_name,tabColour="#B3EBFF")
    #Determine starting row for asset_report
    start_row=nrow(asset_tracking)+8
    asset_idx=which(names(asset_report)=="Asset")
    if(length(asset_idx)==1){
      #Force column to character BEFORE writing
      asset_report[[asset_idx]]=as.character(asset_report[[asset_idx]])
    }
    #Write asset_report to the same sheet
    writeData(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=asset_report,startRow=start_row,startCol=1,colNames=TRUE) #Include column headers
    #Example: table_data is the data frame you are writing starting at start_row
    table_data=asset_report 
    num_rows=nrow(table_data)
    num_cols=ncol(table_data)
    if(company=="Schneider Electric"){
      #Find column indices
      plant_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Plant Name")
      desc_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Description")
      mj_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="MJ1/MJ2")
      #Convert to Excel column letters
      plant_col_letter=int2col(plant_col_idx)
      desc_col_letter=int2col(desc_col_idx)
      #Write formula row by row in the MJ1/MJ2 column
      end_row=nrow(asset_report)+2
      for(r in start_row+1:end_row){
        formula=sprintf('=IF(%s%d="Mt Juliet",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Mt. Juliet 2",%s%d)),"Mt Juliet 2","Mt Juliet 1"),%s%d)',
                        plant_col_letter,r,desc_col_letter,r,plant_col_letter,r)
        writeFormula(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=formula,startCol=mj_col_idx,startRow=r)
      }
    }
    #Bold header row
    header_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_style,rows=start_row,cols=1:num_cols,gridExpand=TRUE)
    #Add filters
    addFilter(wb,sheet=sheet_name,rows=start_row,cols=1:num_cols)
    #Balance Sheet Date styling
    bsd_col=which(colnames(table_data)=="Balance Sheet Date")
    if(length(bsd_col)==1){
      #Header
      bsd_header_style=createStyle(fgFill="#000000",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bsd_header_style,rows=start_row,cols=bsd_col,stack=TRUE)
      #Body
      bsd_body_style=createStyle(fgFill="#BFBFBF",numFmt="mmm-yy")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bsd_body_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=bsd_col,
              gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Find the column index for "MJ1/MJ2"
    mj_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="MJ1/MJ2")
    if(length(mj_col_idx)==1){
      #Header style: purple background, white text
      mj_header_style=createStyle(fgFill="#7030A0",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=mj_header_style,rows=start_row,cols=mj_col_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      #Body style: light purple fill
      mj_body_style=createStyle(fgFill="#E4D2F2")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=mj_body_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=mj_col_idx,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Special columns
    cols_to_format=c("Plant Name","Profit Center","Plant Code","Asset Class Name")
    col_idx=which(names(table_data) %in% cols_to_format)
    if(length(col_idx)>0){
      header_style=createStyle(fgFill="#806000",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
      body_style=createStyle(fgFill="#FFF2CC")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_style,rows=start_row,cols=col_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=body_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=col_idx,
              gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Other columns (orange)
    special_cols=c("Balance Sheet Date","Plant Name","MJ1/MJ2","Profit Center","Plant Code","Asset Class Name","Plant")
    other_cols=setdiff(names(table_data),special_cols)
    other_idx=which(names(table_data) %in% other_cols)
    plant_idx=which(names(table_data)=="Plant")
    header_orange=createStyle(fgFill="#ED7D31",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
    header_plant=createStyle(fgFill="#548235",fontColour="#FFFFFF")
    if(length(other_idx)>0){
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_orange,rows=start_row,cols=other_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    if(length(plant_idx)==1){
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_plant,rows=start_row,cols=plant_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Columns to format as dates
    date_cols=c("Capitalization Date","Acquisition Date")
    for(col_name in date_cols){
      col_idx=which(names(table_data)==col_name)
      if(length(col_idx)==1){
        date_style=createStyle(numFmt="DATE")
        addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=date_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=col_idx,
                  gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      }
    }
    #Accounting columns
    acct_cols=c("Acquisition Value","Accumulated Depreciation","Book Value")
    acct_idx=which(names(table_data) %in% acct_cols)
    if(length(acct_idx)>0){
      acct_style=createStyle(numFmt="ACCOUNTING")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=acct_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=acct_idx,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Asset column as text
    asset_idx=which(names(table_data)=="Asset")
    if(length(asset_idx)==1){
      text_style=createStyle(numFmt="@")
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=text_style,rows=(start_row+1):(start_row+num_rows),cols=asset_idx,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    start_col=ncol(asset_report)-ncol(asset_tracking)+1
    writeData(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=asset_tracking,startRow=2,startCol=start_col)
    #Write Effective Date row (row 1) directly
    cols=colnames(asset_tracking)
    #Create DATE style
    date_style=createStyle(numFmt="DATE",fgFill="#FFFF00")
    #Column index for Asset Class Description
    desc_col=which(cols=="Asset Class Description")+start_col
    writeData(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x="Effective Date:",startRow=1,startCol=desc_col,colNames=FALSE)
    #Yellow fill style for label
    label_style=createStyle(fgFill="#FFFF00")
    #Apply style
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=label_style,rows=1,cols=desc_col,gridExpand=FALSE,stack=TRUE)
    #Map plant location -> effective date
    plant_date_map=setNames(effective_dates_sub$`Effective Date`,effective_dates_sub$`Plant Location`)
    plant_cols=setdiff(cols,c("Asset Class","Asset Class Description"))
    for(col in plant_cols){
      if(col %in% names(plant_date_map)){
        col_index=which(cols==col)
        writeData(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=plant_date_map[col],startRow=1,startCol=col_index+start_col-1,colNames=FALSE)
        #Apply DATE format to that cell
        addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=date_style,rows=1,cols=col_index+start_col-1,gridExpand=FALSE,stack=TRUE)
      }
    }
    #Determine last column based on asset_tracking width
    last_col=start_col+ncol(asset_tracking)-1
    #Header style (bold + fill)
    header_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold",fgFill="#DDEBF7")
    #Apply to entire header row (row 2)
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=header_style,rows=2,cols=start_col:last_col,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Columns to bold
    cols_to_bold=which(colnames(asset_tracking) %in% c("Asset Class","Asset Class Description"))+start_col-1
    #Rows covering the asset_tracking data body
    data_rows=3:(nrow(asset_tracking)+2)
    #Bold style
    bold_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    #Apply style
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bold_style,rows=data_rows,cols=cols_to_bold,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Target descriptions
    target_desc=c("Licenses","Other Intangible Assets","Software")
    #Column index for Asset Class Description
    desc_col=which(colnames(asset_tracking)=="Asset Class Description")+start_col-1
    #Find matching rows in asset_tracking
    match_rows=which(asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description` %in% target_desc)
    #Convert to Excel row numbers (data starts at row 3)
    excel_rows=match_rows+2
    #Red text style
    red_text_style=createStyle(fontColour="#C00000")
    #Apply style
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=red_text_style,rows=excel_rows,cols=desc_col,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Column index for Asset Class (prefer "Asset Class Name" if present)
    asset_col_name=if("Asset Class Name" %in% colnames(asset_report)){
      "Asset Class Name"
    } else if("Asset Class" %in% colnames(asset_report)){
      "Asset Class"
    } else{
      stop("Neither 'Asset Class Name' nor 'Asset Class' found in asset_tracking")
    }
    asset_col=which(colnames(asset_report)==asset_col_name)+start_col
    #Data rows in Excel (data starts at row 3)
    data_rows=3:(nrow(asset_tracking)+2)
    #Styles
    fill_grey=createStyle(fgFill="#F2F2F2")
    top_border_style=createStyle(border="top",borderColour="#000000")
    #Determine which rows have text in Asset Class
    text_rows=which(!is.na(asset_tracking$`Asset Class`) & asset_tracking$`Asset Class`!="")
    excel_text_rows=text_rows+2 #Adjust for Excel row numbers
    #Alternating fill logic
    fill_flag=TRUE #Start with grey
    for(i in seq_along(excel_text_rows)){
      start_row=excel_text_rows[i]
      end_row=if(i<length(excel_text_rows)) excel_text_rows[i+1]-1 else max(data_rows)
      if(fill_flag){
        addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=fill_grey,rows=start_row:end_row,cols=start_col:ncol(asset_report),
                  gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      }
      #Top border on the starting row of the section
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=top_border_style,rows=start_row,cols=start_col:ncol(asset_report),
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      #Flip fill for next section
      fill_flag=!fill_flag
    }
    #Column index for first column
    first_col=start_col
    #Rows covering the table
    table_rows=3:(nrow(asset_tracking)+2) #Adjust for Excel row numbers
    #Create style for right border
    right_border_style=createStyle(border="right",borderColour="#000000")
    #Apply the right border down the first column
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=right_border_style,rows=table_rows,cols=first_col,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Column index for "Asset Class Description"
    desc_col=which(colnames(asset_tracking)=="Asset Class Description")
    #Find the row where Asset Class Description == "TOTAL"
    total_row=which(asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description`=="TOTAL")
    if(length(total_row)==1){
      #Excel row number adjustment (data starts at row 3)
      excel_total_row=total_row+2
      #Columns from Asset Class Description to last column
      cols_total=desc_col:ncol(asset_tracking)+start_col-1
      #Create styles
      top_border_style=createStyle(border="top",borderColour="#0070C0") #Blue color
      bottom_double_border_style=createStyle(border="bottom",borderStyle="double",borderColour="#0070C0")
      #Apply top border
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=top_border_style,rows=excel_total_row,cols=cols_total,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      #Apply bottom double border
      addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=bottom_double_border_style,rows=excel_total_row,cols=cols_total,
                gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Column indices in asset_report
    acq_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Acquisition Value")
    mj_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="MJ1/MJ2")
    #Prefer "Asset Class Name", else "Asset Class"
    if("Asset Class Name" %in% colnames(asset_report)){
      acname_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Asset Class Name")
    } else if("Asset Class" %in% colnames(asset_report)) {
      acname_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Asset Class")
    } else {
      stop("Neither 'Asset Class Name' nor 'Asset Class' column found in asset_report")
    }
    desc_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Description")
    cap_date_col_idx=which(colnames(asset_report)=="Capitalization Date")
    #Convert to Excel letters
    acq_col_letter=int2col(acq_col_idx) #Sum range
    mj_col_letter=int2col(mj_col_idx) #Criteria_range1
    acname_col_letter=int2col(acname_col_idx) #Criteria_range2
    desc_col_letter=int2col(desc_col_idx) #Criteria_range3
    cap_date_col_letter=int2col(cap_date_col_idx) #Criteria_range4
    header_row=start_row #Row 2, your header
    data_start_row=3
    data_end_row=nrow(asset_tracking)-2
    #The column where formulas start (e.g., start_col+2)
    formula_start_col=start_col+2
    formula_end_col=ncol(asset_report) #or however many formula columns
    date_row=1
    location_row=2
    difference=1
    for(c in formula_start_col:formula_end_col){
      formula_col_letter=int2col(c)
      description_col=c-difference
      description_col_letter=int2col(description_col)
      for(r in data_start_row:data_end_row){
        #Build the SUMIFS formula matching your example
        formula=sprintf('=SUMIFS($%s:$%s,$%s:$%s,%s$%d,$%s:$%s,$%s%d,$%s:$%s,">=" & %s$%d)',
                        acq_col_letter,acq_col_letter, #Acquisition Value
                        mj_col_letter,mj_col_letter, #MJ1/MJ2
                        formula_col_letter,location_row, #Location header row
                        acname_col_letter,acname_col_letter, #Asset Class Name
                        description_col_letter,r, #Asset Class Description in this row
                        cap_date_col_letter,cap_date_col_letter, #Capitalization Date
                        formula_col_letter,date_row) #Capitalization Date header row
        writeFormula(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=formula,startCol=c,startRow=r)
      }
      difference=difference+1
    }
    #Column indices
    class_col=formula_start_col-2
    desc_col=formula_start_col-1
    desc_col_letter=int2col(desc_col)
    #Find TOTAL row in asset_tracking (table coordinates)
    total_row_tbl=which(asset_tracking[["Asset Class Description"]]=="TOTAL")
    excel_total_row=total_row_tbl+2
    #Loop across numeric columns
    for(c in formula_start_col:ncol(asset_report)){
      col_letter=int2col(c)
      formula=sprintf("=SUM(%s3:%s%d)",col_letter,col_letter,excel_total_row-1)
      writeFormula(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=formula,startCol=c,startRow=excel_total_row)
    }
    auc_total_row_tbl=which(asset_tracking[["Asset Class Description"]]=="Assets Under Construction")
    excel_auc_total_row=auc_total_row_tbl+2
    real_total_row_tbl=which(asset_tracking[["Asset Class Description"]]=="ELIGIBLE REAL PROPERTY")
    excel_real_total_row=real_total_row_tbl+2
    personal_total_row_tbl=which(asset_tracking[["Asset Class Description"]]=="ELIGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY")
    excel_personal_total_row=personal_total_row_tbl+2
    #Find group header rows in Asset Class column
    group_labels=c("Assets Under Construction","Real Property","Personal Property","Intangible Assets")
    group_rows_tbl=sapply(group_labels,function(lbl){
      which(asset_tracking[["Asset Class"]]==lbl)
    })
    names(group_rows_tbl)=group_labels
    #Add TOTAL row
    group_rows_tbl["TOTAL"]=total_row_tbl
    #Sort rows but keep labels
    group_rows_tbl=group_rows_tbl[order(group_rows_tbl)]
    #Map ELIGIBLE rows in Excel
    eligible_map=c("Assets Under Construction"=excel_auc_total_row,"Real Property"=excel_real_total_row,
                    "Personal Property"=excel_personal_total_row)
    #Write formulas
    labels_sorted=names(group_rows_tbl)
    for(i in seq_along(labels_sorted)){
      lbl=labels_sorted[i]
      #Only do 3 eligible sections
      if(!(lbl %in% names(eligible_map))) next
      start_tbl=group_rows_tbl[lbl]
      #Next header row (or TOTAL)
      next_tbl=group_rows_tbl[i+1]
      #Excel rows
      start_excel=start_tbl+2
      end_excel=next_tbl+1 #tbl+2 then -1
      target_excel_row=eligible_map[lbl]
      for(c in formula_start_col:ncol(asset_report)){
        col_letter=int2col(c)
        formula=sprintf("=SUM(%s%d:%s%d)",col_letter,start_excel,col_letter,end_excel)
        writeFormula(wb,sheet=sheet_name,x=formula,startCol=c,startRow=target_excel_row)
      }
    }
    #Column range for numeric area
    num_start_col=formula_start_col
    num_end_col=formula_start_col+ncol(asset_tracking)-2
    #Row range (Excel rows)
    num_start_row=3
    num_end_row=nrow(asset_tracking)+3
    #Accounting style
    acct_style=createStyle(numFmt="ACCOUNTING")
    #Apply
    addStyle(wb,sheet=sheet_name,style=acct_style,rows=num_start_row:num_end_row,cols=num_start_col:num_end_col,
              gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    message("Asset Report sheet updated.")
    sheet_name_capex="CapEx Tracking"
    capex_header_row=5
    #Check if file exists
    if(file.exists(file_path)){
      #If sheet exists → read it
      if(sheet_name_capex %in% names(wb)){
        capex_tracking=readWorkbook(file_path,sheet=sheet_name_capex,startRow=capex_header_row,detectDates=FALSE,
                                    check.names=FALSE)
        #Restore spaces in column names
        names(capex_tracking)=gsub("\\."," ",names(capex_tracking))
        excel_serial_to_text_date=function(x){
          num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
          is_excel_date=!is.na(num) & num>20000 & num<60000
          out=x
          if(any(is_excel_date)){
            d=as.Date(num[is_excel_date],origin="1899-12-30")
            txt=format(d,"%m/%d/%Y")
            txt=sub("^0","",txt)
            txt=sub("/0","/",txt)
            out[is_excel_date]=txt
          }
          out
        }
        fix_capex=function(x){
          num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
          is_num=!is.na(num)
          out=x
          out[is_num]=format(num[is_num],scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE)
          out
        }
        capex_tracking=capex_tracking%>%mutate(across(everything(),as.character))%>%
                                        mutate(`Start Date`=excel_serial_to_text_date(`Start Date`),
                                                `End Date`=excel_serial_to_text_date(`End Date`),
                                                `CapEx Commitment`=fix_capex(`CapEx Commitment`))
        #Unzip workbook
        temp_dir=tempdir()
        unzip(file_path,exdir=temp_dir)
        #Read workbook + rels
        workbook_xml=read_xml(file.path(temp_dir,"xl/workbook.xml"))
        rels_xml=read_xml(file.path(temp_dir,"xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        ns_wb=xml_ns(workbook_xml)
        ns_rels=xml_ns(rels_xml)
        #Locate sheet
        sheet_node=xml_find_first(workbook_xml,paste0(".//d1:sheet[@name='",sheet_name_capex,"']"),ns_wb)
        if(is.na(sheet_node)){
          stop("Sheet not found.")
        }
        r_id=xml_attr(sheet_node,"id")
        rel_node=xml_find_first(rels_xml,paste0(".//d1:Relationship[@Id='",r_id,"']"),ns_rels)
        sheet_file=xml_attr(rel_node,"Target")
        sheet_path=file.path(temp_dir,"xl",sheet_file)
        sheet_xml=read_xml(sheet_path)
        ns_sheet=xml_ns(sheet_xml)
        #Shared strings
        shared_path=file.path(temp_dir,"xl/sharedStrings.xml")
        shared_strings=NULL
        if(file.exists(shared_path)){
          shared_xml=read_xml(shared_path)
          ns_shared=xml_ns(shared_xml)
          shared_strings=xml_text(xml_find_all(shared_xml,".//d1:si//d1:t",ns_shared))
        }
        #Rows
        rows=xml_find_all(sheet_xml,".//d1:row",ns_sheet)
        row_nums=as.integer(xml_attr(rows,"r"))
        rows_keep=rows[row_nums>=capex_header_row]
        #Extract cells
        cell_list=lapply(rows_keep,function(row_node){
          cells=xml_find_all(row_node,".//d1:c",ns_sheet)
          if(length(cells)==0) return(NULL)
          refs=xml_attr(cells,"r")
          cols=str_extract(refs,"[A-Z]+")
          rows=as.integer(str_extract(refs,"\\d+"))
          types=xml_attr(cells,"t")
          formulas=sapply(cells,function(cell){
            f=xml_find_first(cell,".//d1:f",ns_sheet)
            if(length(f)==0) NA_character_ else xml_text(f)
          })
          values=sapply(seq_along(cells),function(i){
            v=xml_find_first(cells[[i]],".//d1:v",ns_sheet)
            if(length(v)==0) return(NA_character_)
            val=xml_text(v)
            if(!is.null(shared_strings) && !is.na(types[i]) &&types[i]=="s"){
              return(shared_strings[as.integer(val)+1])
            }
            val
          })
          tibble(row=rows,col=cols,formula=formulas,value=values)
        })
        cell_df=bind_rows(cell_list)
        #Choose formula else value
        cell_df=cell_df%>%mutate(content=ifelse(!is.na(formula),paste0("=",formula),value))
        #Build grid
        grid=cell_df%>%select(row,col,content)%>%pivot_wider(names_from=col,values_from=content)%>%arrange(row)
        header=grid%>%dplyr::filter(row==capex_header_row)
        data=grid%>%dplyr::filter(row>capex_header_row)
        #Set column names from header row (excluding row column if present)
        header_vals=header[1,]
        header_vals=header_vals[,colnames(header_vals)!="row",drop=FALSE]
        colnames(data)=colnames(header_vals)
        #Remove row column only if it exists
        if("row" %in% names(data)){
          data=data%>%dplyr::select(-row)
        }
        result=data
        #Remove column A (first column in Excel)
        if(ncol(result)>0){
          result=result[,-1,drop=FALSE]
        }
        #Rename columns to match capex_tracking
        common_n=min(ncol(result),ncol(capex_tracking))
        colnames(result)[1:common_n]=colnames(capex_tracking)[1:common_n]
      } else{
        #Sheet doesn't exist → create empty dataframe
        capex_tracking=data.frame(State=character(),`Facility Address`=character(),`Plant Location`=character(),
                                  Incentive=character(),`CapEx Commitment`=numeric(),`Eligible Expenditures`=numeric(),
                                  `Start Date`=as.Date(character()),`End Date`=as.Date(character()),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
        #Restore spaces in column names
        names(capex_tracking)=gsub("\\."," ",names(capex_tracking))
      }
    } else{
      #File doesn't exist → create dataframe
      capex_tracking=data.frame(State=character(),`Facility Address`=character(),`Plant Location`=character(),
                                Incentive=character(),`CapEx Commitment`=numeric(),`Eligible Expenditures`=numeric(),
                                `Start Date`=as.Date(character()),`End Date`=as.Date(character()),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      #Restore spaces in column names
      names(capex_tracking)=gsub("\\."," ",names(capex_tracking))
    }
    #Helper: month name → number
    month_map=c(January=1,February=2,March=3,April=4,May=5,June=6,July=7,August=8,September=9,October=10,November=11,
                December=12)
    #Determine months to create
    months_to_add=c()
    if(!is.null(month)){
      m_num=month_map[[month]]
      months_to_add=m_num
    } else if(!is.null(quarter)){
      q_start=(quarter-1)*3+1
      months_to_add=q_start:(q_start+2)
    }
    #Create column names like "Jan-24"
    period_cols=format(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01",year,months_to_add)),"%b-%y")
    #Add columns safely even if 0 rows
    for(col in period_cols){
      if(!(col %in% names(capex_tracking))){
        capex_tracking[[col]]=rep(NA,nrow(capex_tracking))
      }
    }
    #Columns that contain Alt+Enter line breaks
    expand_cols=c("Incentives","CapEx Commitment","Eligible Expenditures","Expenditure Type","Incentive Start Date",
                  "Incentive End Date")
    #Ensure columns exist
    expand_cols=intersect(expand_cols,names(effective_dates_sub))
    effective_dates_expanded=effective_dates_sub%>%mutate(across(all_of(expand_cols),~ifelse(is.na(.x)|.x=="",
                                                          NA,str_split(.x,"\\r?\\n|\\r"))))%>%
                                                          unnest(cols=all_of(expand_cols),keep_empty=TRUE)
    #Align effective_dates_expanded to capex_tracking structure
    effective_aligned=effective_dates_expanded%>%transmute(State=State,`Facility Address`=Address,
                                                            `Plant Location`=`Plant Location`,Incentive=Incentives,
                                                            `CapEx Commitment`=`CapEx Commitment`,
                                                            `Eligible Expenditures`=`Eligible Expenditures`,
                                                            `Start Date`=`Incentive Start Date`,
                                                            `End Date`=`Incentive End Date`)
    #Convert EVERYTHING to character in both
    capex_chr=capex_tracking%>%mutate(across(everything(),~as.character(.)))
    effective_chr=effective_aligned%>%mutate(across(everything(),~as.character(.)))
    #Trim whitespace
    capex_chr=capex_chr%>%mutate(across(everything(),~trimws(.)))
    effective_chr=effective_chr%>%mutate(across(everything(),~trimws(.)))
    #Find rows not already present
    rows_to_add=effective_chr%>%anti_join(capex_chr,by=c("State","Facility Address","Incentive","CapEx Commitment",
                                                          "Eligible Expenditures","Start Date","End Date"))
    #Append back (still character-safe)
    if(nrow(rows_to_add)>0){
      capex_chr=bind_rows(capex_chr,rows_to_add)
    }
    #Convert back to original types if desired
    capex_tracking=capex_chr
    capex_tracking=capex_tracking%>%mutate(across(everything(),~trimws(as.character(.))))%>% #Normalize
      filter(if_any(everything(),~!is.na(.) & .!="" & .!="NA"))
    capex_tracking=capex_tracking%>%mutate(`CapEx Commitment`=trimws(`CapEx Commitment`),
                                            `CapEx Commitment`=na_if(`CapEx Commitment`,""),
                                            `CapEx Commitment`=na_if(`CapEx Commitment`,"NA"),
                                            `CapEx Commitment`=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`CapEx Commitment`)))
    capex_tracking=capex_tracking%>%
      #Temporarily normalize blanks and literal "NA" to a placeholder
      mutate(across(c(`State`,`Facility Address`,`Plant Location`,`Incentive`,`CapEx Commitment`,
                      `Eligible Expenditures`),~ifelse(.==""|.=="NA","__NA_BLANK__",.)))%>%
      #Remove duplicates based on these columns
      distinct(`State`,`Facility Address`,`Plant Location`,`Incentive`,`CapEx Commitment`,`Eligible Expenditures`,
                .keep_all=TRUE)%>%
      #Restore the placeholder back to blank (or "NA" if you prefer)
      mutate(across(c(`State`,`Facility Address`,`Plant Location`,`Incentive`,`CapEx Commitment`,
                      `Eligible Expenditures`),~ifelse(.=="__NA_BLANK__","",.)))
    #If file exists, load it; otherwise create new workbook
    if(file.exists(file_path)){
      #Remove existing "CapEx Tracking" sheet if it already exists
      if("CapEx Tracking" %in% names(wb)){
        removeWorksheet(wb,"CapEx Tracking")
      }
    }
    #Add new sheet
    addWorksheet(wb,"CapEx Tracking",tabColour="#7030A0")
    #Write data
    capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`=as.numeric(capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`)
    writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x=capex_tracking,startRow=capex_header_row,startCol=1)
    freezePane(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",firstActiveRow=capex_header_row+1,firstActiveCol=5)
    #Header row index
    num_cols=ncol(capex_tracking)
    #Bold header style
    header_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    #Apply bold to header row
    addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=header_style,rows=capex_header_row,cols=1:num_cols,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Add filters to header row
    addFilter(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",rows=capex_header_row,cols=1:num_cols)
    #Find columns with "MMM-YY" format
    date_col_pattern="^[A-Za-z]{3}-\\d{2}$"
    period_cols_idx=which(grepl(date_col_pattern,names(capex_tracking)))
    #Include "CapEx Commitment" column
    acct_cols_idx=c(which(names(capex_tracking)=="CapEx Commitment"),period_cols_idx)
    if(length(acct_cols_idx)>0){
      #Create ACCOUNTING style
      acct_style=createStyle(numFmt="ACCOUNTING")
      #Apply style to all relevant columns
      addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=acct_style,rows=(capex_header_row+1):(capex_header_row+nrow(capex_tracking)),
                cols=acct_cols_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Write the values to A1 and B1
    writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x=company,startCol=1,startRow=1,colNames=FALSE)
    writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x="CapEx Tracking",startCol=1,startRow=2,colNames=FALSE)
    #Create bold text style
    bold_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    #Apply style to both cells
    addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=bold_style,rows=1:2,cols=1,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Write "Complete" to A3
    writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x="Complete",startCol=1,startRow=3,colNames=FALSE)
    #Create style with green background
    complete_style=createStyle(fgFill="#70AD47")
    #Apply background fill to A3
    addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=complete_style,rows=3,cols=1,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Determine first and last row of data
    first_data_row=capex_header_row+1
    last_data_row=capex_header_row+nrow(capex_tracking)
    #Column A letter
    col_letter="A"
    #Build Excel formula
    count_formula=sprintf("=COUNTA(%s%d:%s%d)",col_letter,first_data_row,col_letter,last_data_row)
    #Write formula to cell A4
    writeFormula(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x=count_formula,startCol=1,startRow=capex_header_row-1)
    #Header row
    col_names=colnames(capex_tracking)
    all_cols=1:ncol(capex_tracking)
    #Identify "MMM-YY" columns
    mmm_yy_cols=grep("^[A-Za-z]{3}-\\d{2}$",col_names)
    other_cols=setdiff(all_cols,mmm_yy_cols)
    #Create styles
    style_other=createStyle(fgFill="#F2F2F2")
    style_mmm=createStyle(fgFill="#DDEBF7")
    #Apply styles to header row only
    if(length(other_cols)>0){
      addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=style_other,rows=capex_header_row,cols=other_cols,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    if(length(mmm_yy_cols)>0){
      addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=style_mmm,rows=capex_header_row,cols=mmm_yy_cols,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    #Determine the row above the header
    label_row=capex_header_row-1
    #First MMM-YY column
    first_mmm_col=min(mmm_yy_cols)
    #Write "CapEx Levels" above the first MMM-YY column and bold it
    writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x="CapEx Levels",startCol=first_mmm_col,startRow=label_row,colNames=FALSE)
    capex_label_style=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=capex_label_style,rows=label_row,cols=first_mmm_col,stack=TRUE)
    #Fill background color for all MMM-YY columns in this label row
    mmm_label_style=createStyle(fgFill="#9BC2E6")
    addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=mmm_label_style,rows=label_row,cols=mmm_yy_cols,stack=TRUE)
    #Find all "NA" strings in capex_tracking
    na_positions=which(capex_tracking=="NA",arr.ind=TRUE) #Gives row & col indices
    #Loop through positions and clear the cells in Excel
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(na_positions))){
      row_excel=na_positions[i,"row"]+capex_header_row #Offset by header row
      col_excel=na_positions[i,"col"]
      writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x="",startRow=row_excel,startCol=col_excel,colNames=FALSE)
    }
    capex_sheet_name="CapEx Tracking"
    asset_header_row=2
    #MMM-YY → Last Day Sheet Name
    mmm_to_sheet=function(mmm){
      first=as.Date(paste0("01-",mmm),format="%d-%b-%y")
      last=seq(first,by="1 month",length.out=2)[2]-1
      format(last,"%m.%d.%Y")
    }
    #Asset Class Rows
    auc_rows=which(grepl("Assets Under Construction",asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description`,ignore.case=TRUE))
    real_rows=which(grepl("ELIGIBLE REAL PROPERTY",asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description`,ignore.case=TRUE))
    pers_rows=which(grepl("ELIGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY",asset_tracking$`Asset Class Description`,ignore.case=TRUE))
    #MMM-YY Columns
    mmm_cols=grep("^[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\\d{2}$",names(capex_tracking),value=TRUE)
    #Match Keys
    match_cols=c("State","Facility Address","Plant Location","Incentive","CapEx Commitment","Eligible Expenditures",
                  "Start Date","End Date")
    capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`=format(capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`,scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE)
    capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`=as.character(capex_tracking$`CapEx Commitment`)
    #Create Row Match Index
    effective_key=effective_aligned%>%unite("key",all_of(match_cols),remove=FALSE)
    capex_key=capex_tracking%>%unite("key",all_of(match_cols),remove=FALSE)
    match_index=match(capex_key$key,effective_key$key)
    #Normalize column names
    normalize_colnames=function(df){
      names(df)=trimws(names(df))
      names(df)=gsub("\\s+"," ",names(df))
      names(df)=gsub("CapE$","CapEx",names(df))
      df
    }
    capex_tracking=normalize_colnames(capex_tracking)
    if(!exists("result")) result=capex_tracking
    result=normalize_colnames(result)
    #Key columns
    key_cols=c("State","Facility Address","Plant Location","Incentive","CapEx Commitment")
    missing_cols=setdiff(key_cols,names(capex_tracking))
    if(length(missing_cols)>0){
      stop("Missing columns in capex_tracking: ",paste(missing_cols,collapse=", "))
    }
    #Month columns
    if(!exists("mmm_cols")){
      mmm_cols=names(capex_tracking)[grepl("^\\w{3}-\\d{2}$",names(capex_tracking))]
    }
    if(length(mmm_cols)==0) stop("No month-year columns found in capex_tracking.")
    #Preview dataframe
    formula_preview=capex_tracking[,key_cols,drop=FALSE]
    formula_preview[,mmm_cols]=NA_character_
    #Key normalization
    normalize_val=function(x){
      x=trimws(as.character(x))
      ifelse(is.na(x)|x==""|x=="NA","<BLANK>",x)
    }
    #Build lookup
    result_keys_norm=as.data.frame(lapply(result[,key_cols],normalize_val),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    result_lookup_key=apply(result_keys_norm,1,paste,collapse="|")
    result_lookup=setNames(seq_len(nrow(result)),result_lookup_key)
    #Column indices
    capex_col_indices=setNames(match(mmm_cols,names(capex_tracking)),mmm_cols)
    #Track unmatched rows
    unmatched_rows=list()
    unmatched_idx=0
    #Main loop
    for(r in seq_len(nrow(capex_tracking))){
      eff_r=match_index[r]
      exp_type=effective_dates_expanded$`Expenditure Type`[eff_r]
      if(is.na(exp_type)||trimws(exp_type)=="") next
      use_auc=grepl("AUC",exp_type,ignore.case=TRUE)
      use_real=grepl("Real",exp_type,ignore.case=TRUE)
      use_pers=grepl("Personal",exp_type,ignore.case=TRUE)
      rows=c(if(use_auc) auc_rows,if(use_real) real_rows,if(use_pers) pers_rows)
      if(length(rows)==0) next
      #Excel column letter
      plant=capex_tracking$`Plant Location`[r]
      asset_col_idx=which(names(asset_tracking)==plant)
      excel_asset_col=ncol(asset_report)-ncol(asset_tracking)+asset_col_idx
      excel_letter=int2col(excel_asset_col)
      #Allowed MMM
      if(!is.null(month) && nzchar(month)){
        month_num=match(month,month.name)
        if(is.na(month_num)) stop("Invalid month name")
        allowed_mmm=format(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,month_num)),"%b-%y")
      } else if(!is.null(quarter)){
        if(!quarter %in% 1:4) stop("Quarter must be 1-4")
        q_months=((quarter-1)*3+1):((quarter-1)*3+3)
        allowed_mmm=format(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01",year,q_months)),"%b-%y")
      } else{
        stop("Provide either month or quarter")
      }
      mmm_cols_use=intersect(mmm_cols,allowed_mmm)
      #Write allowed formulas
      for(col_name in mmm_cols_use){
        sheet_name=mmm_to_sheet(col_name)
        excel_rows=rows+asset_header_row
        ranges=paste0("'",sheet_name,"'!",excel_letter,excel_rows)
        formula=paste0("=SUM(",paste(ranges,collapse=","),")")
        writeFormula(wb,sheet=capex_sheet_name,x=formula,startRow=r+capex_header_row,startCol=capex_col_indices[[col_name]])
        formula_preview[r,col_name]=formula
      }
      #Remaining columns via lookup
      remaining_cols=setdiff(mmm_cols,mmm_cols_use)
      capex_keys_norm=normalize_val(unlist(capex_tracking[r,key_cols]))
      capex_key_str=paste(capex_keys_norm,collapse="|")
      match_row=result_lookup[[capex_key_str]]
      if(!is.null(match_row) && length(match_row)==1){
        for(col_name in remaining_cols){
          formula_to_write=result[match_row,col_name,drop=TRUE]
          formula_to_write=sub("^=+","=",formula_to_write)
          if(!is.na(formula_to_write) && nzchar(formula_to_write)){
            writeFormula(wb,sheet=capex_sheet_name,x=formula_to_write,startRow=r+capex_header_row,
                          startCol=capex_col_indices[[col_name]])
            formula_preview[r,col_name]=formula_to_write
          }
        }
      } else{
        #Unmatched row → add to preview
        unmatched_idx=unmatched_idx+1
        new_row=as.list(rep(NA_character_,ncol(formula_preview)))
        names(new_row)=names(formula_preview)
        for(k in key_cols){
          new_row[[k]]=capex_tracking[r,k]
        }
        for(col_name in mmm_cols_use){
          sheet_name=mmm_to_sheet(col_name)
          excel_rows=rows+asset_header_row
          ranges=paste0("'",sheet_name,"'!",excel_letter,excel_rows)
          formula=paste0("=SUM(",paste(ranges,collapse=","),")")
          new_row[[col_name]]=formula
        }
        unmatched_rows[[unmatched_idx]]=new_row
      }
    }
    #Append unmatched
    if(length(unmatched_rows)>0){
      unmatched_df=do.call(rbind,lapply(unmatched_rows,function(x) as.data.frame(x,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)))
      formula_preview=rbind(formula_preview,unmatched_df)
    }
    #Columns to check
    date_cols=c("Start Date","End Date")
    for(col_name in date_cols){
      col_idx=which(names(capex_tracking)==col_name)
      if(length(col_idx)==1){
        rows_with_date_text=which(grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$",capex_tracking[[col_name]]))
        if(length(rows_with_date_text)>0){
          date_style=createStyle(numFmt="DATE",halign="right")
          for(r in rows_with_date_text){
            excel_date=as.Date(capex_tracking[[col_name]][r],"%m/%d/%Y")
            writeData(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",x=excel_date,startCol=col_idx,startRow=capex_header_row+r,colNames=FALSE)
