            addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=date_style,rows=capex_header_row+r,cols=col_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    #Identify columns
    mmm_cols=grep("^[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{2}$",names(capex_tracking),value=TRUE)
    commit_idx=which(names(capex_tracking)=="CapEx Commitment")
    commit_letter=int2col(commit_idx)
    #Define header row and MMM-YY columns
    commit_idx=which(names(capex_tracking)=="CapEx Commitment")
    commit_letter=int2col(commit_idx)
    mmm_cols=grep("^\\w{3}-\\d{2}$",names(capex_tracking),value=TRUE)
    #Apply header styles only
    if(length(mmm_cols)>0){
      #Non-MMM-YY header fill
      non_mmm_cols=setdiff(1:ncol(capex_tracking),which(names(capex_tracking) %in% mmm_cols))
      if(length(non_mmm_cols)>0){
        addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=createStyle(fgFill="#F2F2F2",textDecoration="bold"),rows=capex_header_row,
                  cols=non_mmm_cols,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
      }
      #MMM-YY header fill
      mmm_idx=which(names(capex_tracking) %in% mmm_cols)
      addStyle(wb,sheet="CapEx Tracking",style=createStyle(fgFill="#DDEBF7",textDecoration="bold"),rows=capex_header_row,
                cols=mmm_idx,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    }
    message("CapEx Tracking sheet updated.")
    #Number of rows needed
    n=nrow(effective_dates_expanded)
    odometers=data.frame("Odometer Name"=character(n),"Title"=character(n),"Subtitle"=character(n),"Start Value"=numeric(n),
                          "End Value"=numeric(n),"Current Value"=numeric(n),"Current Status"=character(n),"Status"=character(n),
                          "Status Color"=character(n),"Note"=character(n),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    names(odometers)=gsub("\\."," ",names(odometers))
    #Clean Plant Location (remove tokens containing numbers)
    clean_plant=function(x){
      x%>%str_split("\\s+")%>%sapply(function(words){
        words[!grepl("\\d",words)]%>%paste(collapse=" ")
      })
    }
    #Build base "Plant Location, State"
    base_loc=paste0(clean_plant(effective_dates_expanded$`Plant Location`),", ",effective_dates_expanded$State)
    #Determine where multiple addresses exist per Plant+State
    addr_counts=effective_dates_expanded%>%mutate(base_loc=base_loc)%>%group_by(base_loc)%>%
      summarise(n_addr=n_distinct(Address,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")
    #Join back to rows
    effective_with_flags=effective_dates_expanded%>%mutate(base_loc=base_loc)%>%left_join(addr_counts,by="base_loc")
    #Final Odometer Name
    odom_names=ifelse(effective_with_flags$n_addr>1 & !is.na(effective_with_flags$Address) & 
                      effective_with_flags$Address!="",paste0(effective_with_flags$Address,", ",effective_with_flags$base_loc),
                      effective_with_flags$base_loc)
    #Ensure same length as effective_dates_expanded
    length(odom_names)==nrow(effective_dates_expanded)
    #Assign into odometers (same row count assumed)
    odometers$`Odometer Name`=odom_names
    odom_mapping=effective_dates_expanded%>%mutate(base_loc=paste0(clean_plant(`Plant Location`),", ",State),
                                                    #Count unique addresses within plant+state
                                                    n_addr=ave(Address,base_loc,FUN=function(x) length(unique(x))),
                                                    #Build odometer name
                                                    odom_name=ifelse(n_addr>1 & !is.na(Address) & Address!="",
                                                                      paste0(Address,", ",base_loc),base_loc))%>%
                                            select(odom_name,Incentives,`CapEx Commitment`,`Eligible Expenditures`,
                                                    `Incentive Start Date`,`Incentive End Date`)
    #Add occurrence id
    odom_mapping=odom_mapping%>%group_by(odom_name)%>%mutate(match_id=row_number())%>%ungroup()
    odometers=odometers%>%group_by(`Odometer Name`)%>%mutate(match_id=row_number())%>%ungroup()
    #Join + Title + Subtitle
    odometers=odometers%>%left_join(odom_mapping,by=c("Odometer Name"="odom_name","match_id"="match_id"))%>%
                          mutate(Title=Incentives,
                                  capex_raw=ifelse(is.na(`CapEx Commitment`)|`CapEx Commitment`==""|`CapEx Commitment`=="NA",
                                                    NA,`CapEx Commitment`),
                                  expend_raw=ifelse(is.na(`Eligible Expenditures`)|`Eligible Expenditures`==""|`Eligible Expenditures`=="NA",
                                                    NA,`Eligible Expenditures`),
        #Start / End Value columns (literal text, TBD handling)
        `Incentive Start Date`=ifelse(is.na(`Incentive Start Date`)|`Incentive Start Date`==""|`Incentive Start Date`=="NA",
                                      "TBD",`Incentive Start Date`),
        `Incentive End Date`=ifelse(is.na(`Incentive End Date`)|`Incentive End Date`==""|`Incentive End Date`=="NA",
                                    "TBD",`Incentive End Date`),
        `Start Value`=0,
        `End Value`=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`CapEx Commitment`)),
        end_txt=`Incentive End Date`,capex_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]","",capex_raw))),
        capex_txt=ifelse(is.na(capex_num),"TBD",paste0("$",sprintf("%.1f",capex_num/1e6),"MM")),
        expend_txt=ifelse(is.na(expend_raw),"TBD",expend_raw),Subtitle=paste(capex_txt,"in",expend_txt,"by",end_txt))%>%
      select(-Incentives,-match_id,-capex_raw,-expend_raw,-capex_num,-capex_txt,-expend_txt,-`CapEx Commitment`,
              -`Eligible Expenditures`,-`Incentive Start Date`,-`Incentive End Date`,-end_txt)
    #Remove existing "Odometers" sheet if present
    if("Odometers" %in% names(wb)){
      removeWorksheet(wb,"Odometers")
    }
    #Add sheet with yellow tab
    addWorksheet(wb,sheetName="Odometers",tabColour="#FFFF00")
    #Write data
    writeData(wb,"Odometers",odometers)
    #Freeze top row
    freezePane(wb,"Odometers",firstRow=TRUE)
    #Add filters
    addFilter(wb,"Odometers",row=1,cols=1:ncol(odometers))
    #Bold text style for headers
    boldHeaderStyle=createStyle(textDecoration="bold")
    #Header style for all columns except "Note"
    headerCols=setdiff(names(odometers),"Note")
    headerStyle=createStyle(fontColour="white",fgFill="#002060",textDecoration="bold")
    addStyle(wb,sheet="Odometers",style=headerStyle,rows=1,cols=which(names(odometers) %in% headerCols),
              gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Header style for "Note" column
    noteCol=which(names(odometers)=="Note")
    noteHeaderStyle=createStyle(fgFill="#FFFF00",textDecoration="bold")
    addStyle(wb,sheet="Odometers",style=noteHeaderStyle,rows=1,cols=noteCol,gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Identify the numeric columns
    accountingCols=which(names(odometers) %in% c("Start Value","End Value","Current Value"))
    #Create style with Accounting number format
    accountingStyle=createStyle(numFmt="ACCOUNTING")
    #Apply style to all rows (except header) in these columns
    addStyle(wb,sheet="Odometers",style=accountingStyle,rows=2:(nrow(odometers)+1),cols=accountingCols,
              gridExpand=TRUE,stack=TRUE)
    #Prepare odometers with correct comma logic
    odometers=odometers%>%mutate(comma_count=str_count(`Odometer Name`,","),
                                  Part1=ifelse(comma_count==2,str_trim(str_split_fixed(`Odometer Name`,",",3)[,1]),
                                                NA_character_),
                                  Part2=ifelse(comma_count==2,str_trim(str_split_fixed(`Odometer Name`,",",3)[,2]),
                                                              str_trim(str_split_fixed(`Odometer Name`,",",2)[,1])),
                                  Part3=ifelse(comma_count==2,str_trim(str_split_fixed(`Odometer Name`,",",3)[,3]),
                                                              str_trim(str_split_fixed(`Odometer Name`,",",2)[,2])),
                                  Eligible_Exp_Extract=str_trim(str_match(Subtitle,"in (.+?) by")[,2]),
                                  Title=str_trim(Title),`End Value`=as.numeric(`End Value`))%>%select(-comma_count)
    clean_plant=function(x){
      sapply(str_split(x,"\\s+"),function(words){
        paste(words[!grepl("\\d",words)],collapse=" ")
      })
    }
    capex_tracking_norm=capex_tracking%>%mutate(`Facility Address`=str_squish(`Facility Address`),
                                                #Remove numeric tokens from Plant Location
                                                `Plant Location`=str_squish(clean_plant(`Plant Location`)),
                                                State=str_squish(State),Incentive=str_squish(Incentive),
                                                `Eligible Expenditures`=str_squish(`Eligible Expenditures`),
                                                `CapEx Commitment`=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`CapEx Commitment`)))
    #Most recent MMM-YY column
    monthly_cols=grep("^[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{2}$",names(capex_tracking_norm),value=TRUE)
    most_recent_col=tail(monthly_cols,1)
    most_recent_col_letter=int2col(which(names(capex_tracking_norm)==most_recent_col))
    #Write formulas
    current_value_col=which(names(odometers)=="Current Value")
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(odometers))){
      match_row=which(capex_tracking_norm$`Plant Location`==odometers$Part2[i] &
                      capex_tracking_norm$State==odometers$Part3[i] &
                      capex_tracking_norm$Incentive==odometers$Title[i] &
                      capex_tracking_norm$`Eligible Expenditures`==odometers$Eligible_Exp_Extract[i] &
                      capex_tracking_norm$`CapEx Commitment`==odometers$`End Value`[i] &
                      (is.na(odometers$Part1[i])|capex_tracking_norm$`Facility Address`==odometers$Part1[i]))
      if(length(match_row)==1){
        excel_row=match_row+capex_header_row
        formula=paste0("='CapEx Tracking'!",most_recent_col_letter,excel_row)
        writeFormula(wb,sheet="Odometers",x=formula,startCol=current_value_col,startRow=i+1)
      } else{
        writeData(wb,sheet="Odometers",x="",startCol=current_value_col,startRow=i+1)
      }
    }
    #Remove helper columns from odometers
    odometers=odometers%>%select(-Part1,-Part2,-Part3,-Eligible_Exp_Extract)
    #Save workbook
    saveWorkbook(wb,file_path,overwrite=TRUE)
    automate_excel_save(file_path)
    #Assuming you have the workbook saved at file_path and the sheet name in variable sheet_name
    odometer_frame=readxl::read_excel(file_path,sheet="Odometers")
    #Month Name → Number
    month_lookup=setNames(1:12,month.name)
    if(!is.na(month)){
      month_num=month_lookup[[month]]
    }
    #Compute As-Of Date
    if(!is.na(month)){
      as_of_date=ceiling_date(as.Date(paste0(year,"-",month_num,"-01")),"month")-days(1)
    } else if(!is.na(quarter)){
      quarter_end_month=c(3,6,9,12)[quarter]
      as_of_date=ceiling_date(as.Date(paste0(year,"-",quarter_end_month,"-01")),"month")-days(1)
    }
    #No leading zero month
    as_of_txt=paste0(month(as_of_date),"/",format(as_of_date,"%d/%y"))
    #Format Value Function
    format_capex_short=function(x){
      x_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
      ifelse(is.na(x_num),NA_character_,ifelse(x_num>=1e6,paste0("$",sprintf("%.2f",x_num/1e6),"MM"),
        ifelse(x_num>=1e5,paste0("$",round(x_num/1e3),"K"),paste0("$",format(round(x_num,0),big.mark=",")))))
    }
    #Build Current Status
    odometer_frame=odometer_frame%>%mutate(curr_val_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Current Value`)),
                                            end_val_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`End Value`)),
                                            capex_txt=format_capex_short(curr_val_num),
                                            completion_txt=ifelse(!is.na(curr_val_num) & !is.na(end_val_num) & curr_val_num>end_val_num,
                                                                  " Completed",""),
                                            `Current Status`=ifelse(is.na(capex_txt),"", #Blank if TBD
                                                              paste0(capex_txt," CapEx",completion_txt," as of ",as_of_txt)))%>%
                                            select(-curr_val_num,-end_val_num,-capex_txt,-completion_txt)
    odometer_frame=odometer_frame%>%mutate(Status=ifelse(grepl("Completed",`Current Status`),"Complete",
                                                  ifelse(`Current Status`==""|is.na(`Current Status`),"Not Started",
                                                          "On Track")))
    #Columns to write
    cols_to_write=c("Current Status","Status")
    data_to_write=odometer_frame[,cols_to_write]
    #Get column numbers in the Excel sheet
    #Replace these with the actual column numbers for "Current Status" and "Status" in your sheet
    current_status_col=which(names(odometers)=="Current Status")
    status_col=which(names(odometers)=="Status")
    #Start row in Excel (assuming row 1 is header)
    start_row=2 #If your headers are in row 1
    #Write "Current Status"
    writeData(wb,sheet="Odometers",x=data_to_write[["Current Status"]],startCol=current_status_col,
              startRow=start_row,colNames=FALSE)
    #Write "Status"
    writeData(wb,sheet="Odometers",x=data_to_write[["Status"]],startCol=status_col,startRow=start_row,colNames=FALSE)
    #Column number for "Status"
    status_col=which(names(odometers)=="Status")
    end_row=start_row+nrow(odometer_frame)-1
    #Create a style for completed status
    complete_style=createStyle(fontColour="#00B050",textDecoration="bold")
    #Apply conditional formatting
    conditionalFormatting(wb,sheet="Odometers",cols=status_col,rows=start_row:end_row,rule='=="Complete"',
                          style=complete_style)
    #Column numbers
    status_color_col=which(names(odometers)=="Status Color") #Status Color column
    #Write the IFS formulas for Status Color
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(odometer_frame))){
      excel_row=start_row+i-1
      status_cell=paste0(int2col(which(names(odometers)=="Status")),excel_row) #e.g., "H2"
      formula=paste0("=_xlfn.IFS(",status_cell,"=\"Complete\",\"Green\",",status_cell,"=\"Not Started\",\"Black\",",
                                  status_cell,"=\"On Track\",\"Blue\",",status_cell,"=\"At Risk\",\"Red\"",")")
      writeFormula(wb,sheet="Odometers",x=formula,startCol=status_color_col,startRow=excel_row)
    }
    #Conditional formatting based on Status Color text
    conditionalFormatting(wb,sheet="Odometers",cols=status_color_col,rows=start_row:end_row,rule='="Blue"',
                          style=createStyle(bgFill="#9BC2E6"))
    conditionalFormatting(wb,sheet="Odometers",cols=status_color_col,rows=start_row:end_row,rule='="Green"',
                          style=createStyle(bgFill="#C6E0B4"))
    conditionalFormatting(wb,sheet="Odometers",cols=status_color_col,rows=start_row:end_row,rule='="Black"',
                          style=createStyle(bgFill="#808080"))
    #Auto-fit column widths
    setColWidths(wb,"Odometers",cols=1:ncol(odometers),widths="auto")
    message("Odometers sheet updated.")
    #Helper: extract year/type/period info from sheet names
    extract_sheet_info=function(name){
      info=list(year=NA,type="other",period=NA)
      if(grepl("^Q[1-4]\\.[0-9]{4}$",name)){
        parts=unlist(strsplit(name,"\\."))
        info$type="quarterly"
        info$year=as.integer(parts[2])
        info$period=as.integer(sub("Q","",parts[1]))*3 #Q1=3, Q2=6, etc.
      } else if(grepl("^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])\\.[0-9]{4}$",name)){
        parts=unlist(strsplit(name,"\\."))
        info$type="monthly"
        info$year=as.integer(parts[2])
        info$period=as.integer(parts[1])
      } else{
        info$year=1900
        info$period=0
      }
      return(info)
    }
    existing_sheets=names(wb)
    #Priority sheets
    priority=c("Combined Asset Data")
    priority_present=intersect(priority,existing_sheets)
    remaining=setdiff(existing_sheets,priority_present)
    #Updated parsing function for sheet info
    extract_sheet_info=function(sheet){
      sheet=str_trim(sheet)
      year=NA_integer_
      type="other"
      period=NA_integer_
      #MM.YYYY
      if(str_detect(sheet,"^\\d{1,2}\\.\\d{4}$")){
        parts=str_split(sheet,"\\.",simplify=TRUE)
        month=as.integer(parts[1])
        year=as.integer(parts[2])
        if(!is.na(month) && month>=1 && month<=12){
          type="monthly"
          period=month
          return(list(year=year,type=type,period=period))
        }
      }
      #QX.YYYY
      if(str_detect(sheet,"^Q[1-4]\\.\\d{4}$")){
        parts=str_split(sheet,"\\.",simplify=TRUE)
        quarter=as.integer(str_remove(parts[1],"Q"))
        year=as.integer(parts[2])
        type="quarterly"
        period=quarter*3
        return(list(year=year,type=type,period=period))
      }
      #If any year found inside sheet name, treat as yearly with period 0
      if(str_detect(sheet,"\\d{4}")){
        year_match=str_extract(sheet,"\\d{4}")
        year=as.integer(year_match)
        type="yearly"
        period=0
        return(list(year=year,type=type,period=period))
      }
      #Fallback: unknown type
      list(year=NA_integer_,type="other",period=NA_integer_)
    }
    #Extract info from remaining sheets
    sheet_info=lapply(remaining,extract_sheet_info)
    sheet_df=data.frame(name=remaining,year=sapply(sheet_info,`[[`,"year"),type=sapply(sheet_info,`[[`,"type"),
                        period=sapply(sheet_info,`[[`,"period"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    #Define type order: yearly > quarterly > monthly > other
    type_levels=c("yearly","quarterly","monthly","other")
    sheet_df$type=factor(sheet_df$type,levels=type_levels)
    #Sort by year descending, then type, then period descending (months/quarters mixed)
    remaining_sorted=sheet_df%>%arrange(year,type,period)%>%pull(name) #Ascending year and period
    #Final ordered list
    ordered=c(priority_present,remaining_sorted)
    #Keep only existing sheets
    ordered=ordered[ordered %in% existing_sheets]
    #Map to workbook indices
    idx=match(ordered,existing_sheets)
    idx=idx[!is.na(idx)] #Remove any NA
    #Reorder workbook sheets
    worksheetOrder(wb)=idx
    wb$ActiveSheet=1L
    #Save workbook
    saveWorkbook(wb,file_path,overwrite=TRUE)
    cat("Workbook sheet order updated:\n",paste(ordered,collapse=", "),"\n")
    end_time_1=Sys.time()
    time_elapsed_1=as.numeric(difftime(end_time_1,start_time_1,units="secs"))
    format_elapsed=function(elapsed){
      elapsed=as.numeric(elapsed,units="secs") #convert to numeric seconds
      hrs=floor(elapsed/3600)
      mins=floor((elapsed %% 3600)/60)
      secs=round(elapsed %% 60,2)
      parts=c()
      if(hrs>0){
        parts=c(parts,sprintf("%d %s",hrs,ifelse(hrs==1,"hour","hours")))
      }
      if(mins>0){
        parts=c(parts,sprintf("%d %s",mins,ifelse(mins==1,"minute","minutes")))
      }
      #Always show seconds
      parts=c(parts,sprintf("%.2f %s",secs,ifelse(secs==1,"second","seconds")))
      paste(parts,collapse=" ")
    }
    #Build report label
    if(!is.null(month)){
      report_type="monthly"
      month_upper=paste0(toupper(substr(month,1,1)),tolower(substr(month,2,nchar(month))))
      report_label=paste0(month_upper," ",year)
    } else if(!is.null(quarter)){
      report_type="quarterly"
      report_label=paste0("Q",quarter," ",year)
    } else{
      report_type="unspecified"
      report_label=year
    }
    #Using paste0 to avoid extra spaces
    cat(paste0("It took ",format_elapsed(time_elapsed_1)," to complete the ",report_type," report for ",report_label,".\n"))
  }
  #Run reports
  if(!is.null(start_month) && !is.null(end_month)){
    #Convert month names to numbers
    start_month_num=match(tolower(start_month),tolower(month.name))
    end_month_num=match(tolower(end_month),tolower(month.name))
    #Generate continuous sequence of months
    all_months=seq(from=(start_year-1)*12+start_month_num,to=(end_year-1)*12+end_month_num)
    #Convert back to months and years
    months=month.name[((all_months-1) %% 12)+1]
    years=((all_months-1) %/% 12)+1
    #Build periods data frame
    periods=data.frame(Month=months,Year=years)
    #Run the model
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(periods))){
      report_function(company=company,month=periods$Month[i],quarter=NULL,year=periods$Year[i])
    }
  } else if(!is.null(start_quarter) && !is.null(end_quarter)){
    #Generate continuous sequence of quarters
    all_quarters=seq(from=(start_year-1)*4+start_quarter,to=(end_year-1)*4+end_quarter)
    #Convert back to quarters and years
    quarters=((all_quarters-1) %% 4)+1
    years=((all_quarters-1) %/% 4)+1
    #Build periods data frame
    periods=data.frame(Quarter=quarters,Year=years)
    #Run the model
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(periods))){
      report_function(company=company,month=NULL,quarter=periods$Quarter[i],year=periods$Year[i])
    }
  } else{
    stop("You must provide either start/end months or start/end quarters.")
  }
}
